entities.summary: Agnieszka Bednarek-Kasza is a Polish volleyball player, a member of Poland women's national volleyball team and Polish club KPS Chemik Police, a participant of the Olympic Games Beijing 2008, bronze medalist of the European Championship 2009, Polish Champion.
